turns.q: How many days do I have to return something?
turns.replyTail:
It depends on the product:

100 nights from delivery: mattresses, bed bases, beds, sofa beds, toppers and children’s products.
30 days from receipt: bed linen and mattress protectors. These are not covered by the 100-night trial.
14 calendar days from receipt: the legal withdrawal period for any product.

The product must be returned in acceptable condition and not damaged by use.

turns.q: How long until I get my refund once you receive it?
turns.replyTail:
Once we receive the return at our warehouse, the refund is issued within:

72 hours for large items such as mattresses, bed bases, headboards and sofa beds.
15 business days for small parcels such as bed linen, duvets and pillows.

After the refund is issued, your bank may take around 72 hours, sometimes a few business days, to show the money in your account.

turns.q: Do I need the original packaging to return something?
turns.replyTail:
No. The original packaging is not required for a return.

For large items, mattresses do not need to be rolled into their original carton. Please prepare bulky products so they can pass through doors and stairways. For small parcels, the original box is useful if you still have it, but it is not mandatory.

The product should be complete and in acceptable condition.

turns.q: How do I track the status of my refund?
turns.replyTail:
You can track your refund in the return portal: https://www.tediber.com/a/return

Log in with the email address used for the order and your 6-digit order number. Then open the “Already returned” section to view your return file and its status.

The refund is sent to your original payment method. If it has not arrived within 25 days after the warehouse received your return, let me know here.
